hypothesis: Under identical 10 initial and 6 subsequently observed real source interventions, greedily choosing six action-context probes that maximally split a source-consistent causal hypothesis committee gives lower held-out binary causal-composition Brier than both outcome-independent fixed-order and uniform-random action selection, in relabeled but hidden donor worlds. The exact identical conventional active-Bayes policy must tie; no native or scientific advantage is claimed.
question: Can a native cold-checkpoint-supported causal committee reduce remaining target ambiguity through real interventions, not more source labels or hidden outcomes, while retaining correct confidence and quartic out-of-class vetoes?
source_worlds: Reuse unchanged CKAD35 synthetic 5-context-bit plus 1-action world family and isolated donor source functions with fresh seed IDs; three relabeled source-family targets, three quartic-perturbed negative targets; donor identity, permutations, output flips, negative family and hidden consequences withheld from policies.
split: Deterministic outcome-free full-rank-42 donor public inputs. Independently SHA-rank the 64 target input IDs without any outcome: first 10 common initial witnessed actions, next 16 COMMON HELD action inputs evaluator-only, remaining 38 form action-probe pool. Each policy may choose exactly SIX distinct actions from that same 38-set pool, conditional on its own observed source outcomes only. No policy can select or inspect held inputs or source outcomes for another policy.
policies: active_native: source-consistent analogue committee from three cold native numerical donor checkpoints, choosing each next action by maximized posterior binary-entropy / balanced partition, update only on revealed consequences; no guessed source writes
active_exact_conventional: independently GF2-fitted donor functions with identical 23040 possible transforms; same active action selection, must match native active actions and posteriors exactly
fixed: six predetermined input-only public actions from the 38 candidate pool, no outcome-dependent choice
random: six reproducible uniformly sampled distinct actions from same pool (target/seed-specific random state, never read any outcome to choose)
initial10: ten common witnessed actions alone (no six extra observations) for attribution/negative development ablation
arms: For each action policy compute 16-held-input analogical posterior-composite Brier. For each policy also compute target-only unmodified NativeCumulativeLearner and independent conventional GF2 from exact 16 per-target witnessed source outcomes, with calibrated posterior and confidence scores, and the 0.5 sham. Include fully fitted polynomial logistic from 16 target witnesses. Strongest control is conventional active-Bayesian with same 23040 policy and data; candidate parity expected.
memory: Source donor checkpoint learned using unchanged NativeContextAccumulator from 3×42 genuine source interventions; byte-exact cold restore. Four additional independent pressure slots each receive 42 witnessed input-output pairs in unchanged native component. Verify all 64 old donor reads and all stored target-only reads unchanged, source custody, duplicate/conflict atomicity. No changing accepted runtime or creating a new learner.
budget: Per arm and seed: 3 donors×42=126 source + 6 target slots×(10 common initial+6 policy-specific witnessed interventions)=96 +4 pressure slots×42=168, total 390 source outcomes/arm/seed. Across arms queried actions can differ; never imply physical unique-world query count is the same. 16 common held actions per each six target slots =96 held primitive labels; 16×3 graphs×2 families =96 held composite cases/arm/seed. Control actions/labels matched within each policy, output source logs/probes and CPU timings.
metrics: Held causal-composition Brier lower better, primitive 0.9-confidence commitment and false confident count, active-vs-fixed/random absolute gain per seed, held input IDs, exact action sequence and witnessed outcomes per policy, posterior survivor counts, OOD zero-survivor rejection count, native-to-conventional posterior/action parity, baseline Brier, cold retention and wall/CPU model cost, source JSON SHA/provenance.
frozen_gate: Pilot GO if BOTH seeds: active native in-family held composite Brier <=0.08; active improves Brier >=0.03 absolute versus BOTH fixed and random (all equal six probe budget), active improves >=0.03 versus matched target-only native and full-degree3 GF2; >=0.50 confident held primitive coverage with ZERO incorrect high-confidence commitments; source-only calibrated active OOD hypothesis exhaustion in >=2 of 3 quartic targets and ZERO accepted high-confidence OOD incorrect predictions; active OOD Brier <= fixed OOD Brier; active actions/forecasts EXACTLY match independently implemented conventional active Bayesian policy; all source integrity, native cold, 64-input retention, contradiction atomicity PASS. Otherwise SCREEN_NO_GO or INVALID (custody). Do not interpret an active gain as scientific superiority because conventional active policy ties.
promotion: Primary seeds 23961/23962/23963 remain UNUSED even if engineering pilot GO. No merge/promotion/accepted Yggdrasil ref changes, Forge controller or runtime, live source, first-use owner, scheduled task, paid API or science acceptance without separately verified authorization.
audit: Prereg BEFORE source implementation and pilot first-use. Freeze exact Git blob + Python pinned dependencies + audit source before original two pilots. On completion seal each original source/proposal trace, independent re-implementation of active entropy objective plus all Brier scores without importing candidate; GitHub exact-tree Linux/Windows full regression. Fail closed if ANY held label influences action proposals, action count differs, sources mismatch, or cross-arm data used.
scientific_limit: A conventional externally enumerated context-permutation analogue over unchanged native donor weights is not an endogenous non-transformer intelligence capability. Source-derived intervention value is a policy-level engineering method, not unbounded causal discovery. Equal conventional active Bayesian control forbids SCIENTIFIC_PASS on this experiment.
expected_environment: GitHub-hosted Python 3.12, numpy==2.3.5 scipy==1.16.3 scikit-learn==1.8.0 joblib==1.5.2 threadpoolctl==3.6.0; no network model inference, paid API, local computer or private GPU.
